row.body: The shelter key is packed with a note promising it will stay hidden; the entry sheet says the gate was opened for a scheduled pickup that never arrived.
row.title: A shelter kept secret

cites.quote: They'll never find us here, trust me

sidecar.gloss: A hidden shelter is opened for a pickup that does not arrive.
sidecar.rival_reading: A field crew could use a private shelter and schedule a supply run; the missed pickup does not identify who ordered it.
